evaluation.landmark: After first proposed action batch and returned native observation
evaluation.failure: No native success within the fixed horizon
evaluation.primary_exclusions: Already complete, terminal, or out of budget at landmark
evaluation.fit: StandardScaler then L2 logistic regression, C=1, development only
evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired family resamples conditional on the development fit

publication_scope: Aggregate configuration only; private per-episode seeds and trajectories are not redistributed. This is not sufficient for an end-to-end rerun.
